summary: Defines a basic set of SNMP managed objects for the events that can be generated by PacketCable and IPCablecom compliant Multimedia Terminal Adapter devices. This is a Proposed Standard, later updated by RFC 9141.

eli5.summary: Cable-phone adapter boxes can report things that happen to them. This memo makes a standard list of what they can report to the people running the network.

questions: snmp events for cable voice adapters
